title: Colours and shapes
examples: Can you name the primary colours?
How do I find a square?

explain.say: Today you will learn about shapes and colours.
A circle is round. A circle has no straight sides.
A square has four straight sides. All four sides are the same length.
A triangle has three straight sides and three corners.
Red, blue and yellow are the primary colours. You mix them to make other colours.
Look around you for a circle. A clock face is often a circle.

faq.q: What is the difference between a square and a rectangle?
faq.a: A square is a special kind of rectangle. All four of its sides are the same length.
asks: What is the rule for a square's sides?

faq.q: Are there colours that are not primary colours?
faq.a: Yes. When you mix colours, you make new colours. Blue and yellow make green.
asks: What colours are made by mixing?
What colours do I need to mix?

faq.q: How many sides does a triangle have?
faq.a: A triangle always has three straight sides. It has three corners too.
asks: How many sides does a triangle have?

faq.q: Can a circle have straight sides?
faq.a: No. A circle is round, so it has no straight sides.

faq.q: Are all primary colours always the same?
faq.a: In painting, the primary colours are red, blue and yellow. You cannot make them by mixing other paints.

facts: A circle is a perfectly round shape.
A square has four sides, and all sides are equal.
A triangle has three straight sides.
The three primary colours are red, blue, and yellow.

quiz.say: Which shape has three straight sides?
quiz.why: Count the sides of a triangle: one, two, three.

wrong.0: A square has four straight sides.
wrong.2: A circle is round, so it has no straight sides.

quiz.say: Mix blue and yellow paint. Which colour do you make?
quiz.why: Blue and yellow paint mix to make green.

wrong.1: Purple comes from mixing red and blue.
wrong.2: Orange comes from mixing red and yellow.

quiz.say: Which shape has four sides that are all the same length?
quiz.why: A square has four sides, and every side is the same length.

wrong.0: A rectangle has four sides, but two are long and two are short.
